title: sales partnership scratch notes - Acme Corp research + outreach
content:
Purpose
- Quick scratchpad for Acme Corp outbound / partnership thoughts. Save for call prep + shared with Liam/Nicole. Not polished.

Account snapshot (top-level)
- Company: Acme Corp (Industry: e-commerce / marketplace)
- HQ: Seattle, WA
- Estimated ARR: ~$250M (public filings + Crunchbase)
- Tech org: small platform infra + growing ML org (hiring MLEs in job postings)
- Relevant signals: posted job for "search relevance engineer" (likely heavy embedding/semantic search use), press on new personalization product in Nov 2025, raised Series D 2024.

Why Redwood might fit
- Use case fit: realtime product personalization + on-site search ranking -> need low-latency, cost-predictable embeddings + reranking.
- Deployment needs: they mentioned compliance + data isolation in RFP notes -> Dedicated or Private likely required.
- Cost sensitivity: high token volume (search + personalization) -> optimize batching, caching, quantization. Redwood Optimize + Dedicated could reduce unit costs vs cloud-hosted endpoints.

Key stakeholders (from LinkedIn + notes)
- VP Product: Jenna Park (leads personalization/product ML) -> primary technical champion target.
- Head of Platform: Marco Alvarez (owns infra & cost) -> cares about dedicated capacity, SLAs, network/VPC.
- Procurement contact: Sarah Lin (procurement) -> timeline: Q3 procurement cycle.

Notes from discovery assets / RFP (internal doc CONFLUENCE: acme-enterprise-profile)
- RFP asks: model explainability for ranking, encrypted KV cache, integration with on-prem data stores.
- Concern: vendor lock-in and ability to switch model versions.
- Performance targets: p50 latency < 60ms for reranking requests at 128 token contexts.

Outbound email drafts (short / multi-touch sequence)
1) Cold intro (subject options: "Reduce rerank latency for Acme search by 2x")
Subject: Quick idea to reduce search latency at Acme
Hi Jenna,
Saw Acme's new personalization work and open search roles — congrats. We help product teams reduce online rerank latency and cost by combining model routing, KV prefix caching, and dedicated inference pools.
Any interest in a 15 min intro next week? Happy to share a short case study (marketplace customer reduced median rerank latency from 120ms -> 45ms).
Best,
Priya (Redwood Inference)

2) Follow-up (if no reply)
Subject: Case study + 2 quick ideas for Acme search
Jenna — quick follow: two low-effort ideas we shared with similar marketplace teams:
- Prefix caching for repeat query patterns -> cuts token cost by ~30%
- Canary routing: cheaper model for tail queries to keep latency predictable
If you're open, can share the config and numbers. 10–15 min?

Call / discovery script (bullet points)
- Intro (30s) + confirm role: "Are you responsible for search/ personalization infra?"
- Current infra: in-house or cloud managed? What models for reranking/embeddings?
- Volume: qps for search rerank, typical context length, SLA pain points.
- Sensitivity: data residency/compliance needs (do you need VPC/on-prem?)
- Cost targets and who owns budget for inference.
- Success metric for pilot: latency, cost per thousand requests, accuracy acceptable delta.

Objections + suggested responses (scratchy)
- "We already use [cloud vendor] managed endpoints" -> Acknowledge. Ask: is cost predictable at scale? We can run a quick TCO comparison using your qps/seq length and show potential savings with caching/batching and reserved capacity.
- "Vendor lock-in / switching risk" -> We support standard model formats and can route to alternative model variants; customers use rollouts to validate before migrating. Also offer Private deployment if you need on-prem.
- "Security / compliance concerns" -> Offer Dedicated with customer-managed VPC, KMS integration, and audit log hooking. Can share SOC2 + security brief quickly.
- "We don't have cycles to run a pilot" -> Offer a lightweight POC: 2-week lab with small test corpus, pre-configured templates, Redwood handles infra onboarding. Minimal effort from their side (1-2 engineers).

Potential pilot (2-week) scope idea
- Integrate Redwood Dedicated to serve rerank model (open model or their model) for a subset of queries (10% traffic)
- Measure: p50/p95 latency, cost per 1k requests, quality regression (simple A/B with existing ranker)
- Deliverables: config + rollout policy, cost analysis, short exec summary

Open questions / TODOs
- Need to confirm Jenna's email and best intro path (Marco or Jenna?). Liam to check existing intro in CRM.
- Pull traffic numbers (qps, tokens per request) from CRM by 2026-03-05.
- Draft technical one-pager tailored to their RFP: include dedicated capacity options + KMS info (Nicole owns).
- Prepare short marketplace case study (privacy-conscious anonymized metrics).

Internal asks for Liam/Nicole
- Liam: check CRM for contact freshness + any previous outreach notes (OPPS-4521).
- Nicole: security brief + SOC2 + KMS integration docs for sharing with procurement.

Misc scratch items / voice notes
- Potential pricing anchor: show 20–30% unit cost reduction vs managed endpoints at 100k qps w/ batching & caching (need to validate with bench).
- Risk: they might insist on in-house model training -> highlight that Redwood can serve customer-owned models in Private deployment.

Quick snapshot of outreach timeline
- 2026-03-02: initial email (send)
- 2026-03-09: follow-up
- 2026-03-16: call attempt / calendar push

Notes to self
- Keep this doc as live scratch. Move polished items to Confluence page once we have pilot scope.
- When prepping one-pager, include a tiny diagram of routing + cache flow (visual helps procurement).

---
End of notes (rough)
